successors.name: Republic of China
successors.text: 'returned to the Republic of China on 1 October 1930'; Liugong Island and its facilities 'leased back to the U.K. until 1940'

ledger.x: 1 July 1898: the core area 'was ruled by the British from 1 July 1898 to 1930 under a lease agreement with the Chinese empire'; 'The Japanese returned China Weihaiwei on 24 May 1898, after which it was occupied by the British.'
1 October 1930: 'became an integral part of China after it was returned to the Republic of China on 1 October 1930'.

certainty.note: The page gives neither an area nor a boundary for the leasehold; the radius is a stand-in.
